newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine May supermarket sales up 9.6 pct vs '96.
newsitem.headline: Argentine May supermarket sales up 9.6 pct vs '96.

text.p: Argentine supermarket sales rose to $841 million in May, an increase of 9.6 percent from the same month a year earlier, according to preliminary figures released Tuesday by the Economy Ministry.
The May sales represented a rise of 4.5 percent from a month earlier. In April there were sales worth $804 million, a 3.5 percent rise from the same month in 1996.
The ministry said "with these May sales estimates, sales in the first five months of the year would be 6.1 percent higher than those in the same period in 1996."
The monthly supermarket report anticipated that sales in June would be three percent higher than in May, which would bring the increase from May 1996 to eight percent.
